notes.title: Public Demo is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Our Public Demo is Live! [/h1]

Hey everyone! 😊

We’re beyond excited(and a little nervous too) to announce that our very own public demo is finally LIVE on steam! Lots of hard work and plenty of late nights have been put towards it and we’re really eager for you guys to try it out and give us feedback!

[h2][b]What’s in the demo?[/b][/h2]

The demo will give you a taste of what we’ve been working on. It's about an hour of gameplay where you’ll get to experience some of the world and challenges of Sojourn Past(and also see a bit of the story). It’s just a preview, but we hope it gives you a glimpse of the world we’re building, and we can’t wait for you to check it out.

[h3][b]A Few Quick Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Bug reports: [/b]Since the game is still in development, you might run into bugs! If We’d love it if you could report them over on our discord. Link -> [url=https://discord.gg/fxYMhZWP2h]https://discord.gg/fxYMhZWP2h. [/url]

[b]Feedback: [/b]If you have any feedback we would love to hear it!-> [url=https://forms.gle/ShrpCSj3YURAavSp9]https://forms.gle/ShrpCSj3YURAavSp9[/url]

[b]Steam Deck Support:[/b] Although not verified for Steam Deck, Sojourn Past should work okay on the Steam Deck. Let us know if you face any problems.

And hey, if you’re sharing your experience on Twitter/X, we’d be so happy if you tagged us @Sojourn_Past or used the hashtag #SojournPast. We’d love to see your screenshots or hear all about your adventure with the demo. 💙

That’s it for now! We hope you have a great time playing the demo!

Best,
ReDimension Team
